chapter: C.L. Burke and Kid Ory years
title: Why he left Ory
summary: He quit in July 1949, exhausted and frustrated by Ory's repetitive New Orleans repertoire.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Ory stayed at the Cavern three or four months with Teddy Buckner in my place after I left.
Do you mind me asking, were you just sort of exhausted at the time?
I was kind of exhausted, kind of frustrated because I didn't like Ory's style of playing. The music he was playing was very monotonous, playing the same old New Orleans tunes night

to playing
after night. I'm used a variety of tunes,
anything and everything.
This is a more dixie-land repetoire.
